description: Unit test class for EmployeeWorkExperienceDao, testing CRUD operations and search functionality related to employee work experience data in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeWorkExperienceDao functionalities, including retrieval, creation, editing, deletion, and searching of employee work experience data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of EmployeeWorkExperienceDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeWorkExperienceById
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO correctly retrieves employee work experience data for a given ID and employee number.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests the deletion of multiple employee work experience records.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests searching employee work experience based on filter parameters, asserting the correct count and data type.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeWorkExperienceWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with a limit on results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Validates saving a new employee work experience record and verifies field values.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Checks updating an existing employee work experience record.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencesCount
methods.description: Ensures that the count of employee work experiences matching search criteria is accurate.
